skill.summary: Integrate and track multi-platform passive income with categorization, trend analysis, AI forecasting, tax reports, and financial goal monitoring.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Passive-Income-Tracker Skill.

- Integrates multiple passive income platforms for unified income tracking.
- Automatically categorizes income sources and provides visual trend analysis.
- Includes AI-powered financial forecasting and automated tax report generation.
- Enables financial goal setting and tracking.
- Supports secure local data storage and manual data import.
